pageHeading: cy Who is named on your tenancy agreement
pageInfo1: cy You are a tenant if you are the only person named on the tenancy agreement. This includes if you’re in a shared property with others who have their own individual tenancy agreements with the landlord.
pageInfo2: cy You are a joint tenant if you signed the tenancy agreement with one or more people and are named with them and the landlord on the same tenancy agreement.
questionTitle: cy Are you a tenant or joint tenant?

tenant.hint: cy You and the landlord are the only people named on the tenancy agreement

jointTenant.label: cy Joint tenant
jointTenant.hint: cy You and one or more other people are named on the same tenancy agreement with the landlord
